regions.region: page 1 title, author block, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and the aggregate electrochemical bromocyclization claim. The graphical abstract is a generic method summary, not a unique experiment row.
Representative bioactive spirocycles are contextual examples only; no synthesis arrows or current-paper experiments are present.
Scheme 1b is a generic challenge map with possible products A/B/C; Scheme 1c is the generic current reaction class. Both are classified as general schemes rather than reported substrate experiments.

The prose narrates Table 1 entries 1–8, including the 87% standard run, zero-current failure, alternative bromide salts, KBr stoichiometry, and solvent-ratio tests. These are linked to the page-2 table rows rather than duplicated.

unresolved: Generic Scheme 1 R/Y/X variables do not define unique structures or experiment-specific yields.
No SI association was inferred from the availability badge or URL.

regions.region: page 2 upper-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–14, and footnotes a–g
regions.finding: Fourteen independent optimization runs were retained with row salt, stoichiometry, solvent ratio/volume, current, time, charge override, scale override, NMR yield, no-current failure, and the entry-14 isolated yield. Entry 14 is merged with Scheme 2 product 2a and Scheme 5 entry 1.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Scheme 2 reaction header, products 2a–2r and 3a/4a, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: The 2a run is already Table 1 entry 14; nineteen other distinct scope experiments were recorded. Footnote reagent substitutions for KCl/KI and the 2l 2.8 F/mol override are explicit.
Narrative ring-size, functional-group, and substrate-class statements support Scheme 2 labels but do not create additional experiments.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right chirality, scale-up, and product-transformation prose
regions.finding: The prose introduces the two chiral runs, distinct 4.0 mmol 1g scale-up, and four 2g transformations shown on page 3. Those records merge the page-2 prose with the page-3 arrows.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits reaction times, workups, purification, product masses, and explicit yield bases for most rows.
Page-2 prose swaps the corresponding R/S product order relative to Scheme 3; the conflict remains unresolved.

regions.finding: Two independent 1.0 mmol enantioenriched reactions were recorded with starting ee, product yield, product ee, and displayed R/S labels. The scheme/prose stereochemical-label conflict is retained.
A separate 4.0 mmol 1g scale-up gives 0.93 g 2g in 73% under 80 mL CH3CN/H2O and 3.4 F/mol; it is not merged with the 1.0 mmol scope row.
Four distinct 2g transformations were recorded arrow-by-arrow. The NiCl2/NaBH4 reduction preserves -44 °C/14 h, an untimed warming transition, and room-temperature/10 h as ordered stages.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Figure 1 and cyclic-voltammetry discussion
regions.finding: Cyclic voltammetry is mechanistic/analytical evidence (oxidation peaks at 1.0 and 1.4 V) rather than a preparative reaction record.

Standard entry 1 is the existing Table 1 entry 14. Three distinct Br2 controls were retained, including separate dropwise-addition timing and the unresolved relationship to the printed 2 h reaction period.

regions.region: page 3 center-right Scheme 6 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: The anodic Br−/Br2/Br3− sequence, proposed bromonium int. I, anti cyclization, and cathodic water reduction are one proposed mechanism record, not isolated experiments.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right Supporting Information availability statement
regions.finding: The page says SI is available online, but the workspace source mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI facts were imported or inferred.

unresolved: Yield bases, workups, purification, and most product masses are omitted from Schemes 3–5.
The Scheme 5 2 h period is not explicitly defined as inclusive of or subsequent to the 1.5 h addition.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left associated-content continuation and accession code
regions.finding: The page lists the types of SI and CCDC 2366054, but no workspace SI file is explicitly associated. Crystal deposition is characterization, not another reaction or machine-structure verification.

Biao Wang is thanked for reproducing results of 2n, 2h, and (R)-2h. No independent charges, conditions, yields, or run identifiers are given, so provenance notes are attached to existing records and no duplicate experiment is created.
Author metadata and bibliography only; cited literature was not expanded into experiments of the current paper.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not define separable experimental runs.
CCDC 2366054 and the SI URL were not treated as an associated workspace SI file.

regions.finding: The page contains bibliography only. Prior electrochemical halogenations, NBS cyclizations, and cited transformations are literature references, not current-paper experiments and were not imported.

unresolved: No current-paper reaction arrow, table row, experimental procedure, or result is present on page 5.
